areas.label: Code, Optimization & Chemistry
areas.description: These papers use language models and agents to write, test and repair code, solve software engineering tasks, discover algorithms through evolutionary search and design molecules and drugs.

areas.label: Vision-Language Models
areas.description: These papers build, benchmark and diagnose vision-language models for images, charts, documents, video, spatial reasoning and embodied action, with work on hallucination and efficient visual tokens.

areas.label: Fine-Tuning & Preference Alignment
areas.description: These papers adapt pretrained models through preference optimization, domain fine-tuning and low-rank adapters while limiting catastrophic forgetting.

areas.label: Factuality, Evaluation & Expert Domains
areas.description: These papers study calibration, fact-checking, knowledge editing, benchmarks and annotation, and apply language models to legal, financial, scientific and enterprise documents.

areas.label: Speech & Audio Models
areas.description: These papers build and evaluate speech and audio-language models for recognition, synthesis, translation, spoken dialogue and audio reasoning.

areas.label: LLM Agents
areas.description: These papers train and benchmark language agents for tool use, web search, GUI control, long-horizon tasks and multi-agent collaboration, along with skill libraries and agentic reinforcement learning.

areas.label: Linguistics, Multilinguality & Translation
areas.description: These papers compare models with human language processing, study cross-lingual transfer, dialects and tokenization, and improve and evaluate machine translation.

areas.label: Social Behavior, Bias & Culture
areas.description: These papers probe the social, cultural and psychological behavior of language models, covering bias, sycophancy, theory of mind, role-play, personalization, user simulation and LLM judges.

areas.label: LLM Safety & Security
areas.description: These papers attack and defend language models and agents through jailbreaks, prompt injection, backdoors, watermarking, privacy protection and safety alignment.

areas.label: Retrieval & Structured Knowledge
areas.description: These papers improve retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation and reason over knowledge graphs, tables, databases, entities and events, including recommendation systems.

areas.label: Long-Term Agent Memory
areas.description: These papers design and benchmark long-term memory systems that let conversational and personalized agents extract, organize and retrieve past information.

areas.label: Reasoning & Reinforcement Learning
areas.description: These papers improve and analyze model reasoning through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, efficient chain-of-thought, mathematical problem solving and faithfulness diagnostics.

areas.label: Text Generation, Style & Detection
areas.description: These papers analyze writing style and creativity, detect machine-generated text, generate synthetic training data and produce visual artifacts such as webpages and SVG graphics.

areas.label: Sequence Model Architectures
areas.description: These papers analyze and redesign Transformers, linear attention, state-space models and hybrid architectures, covering positional encoding and attention sinks.

areas.label: Medical & Clinical NLP
areas.description: These papers build and evaluate models for medical question answering, clinical reasoning over health records and radiology report generation.

areas.label: Efficient LLMs & Decoding
areas.description: These papers make language models faster and smaller through pruning, quantization, KV cache compression, mixture-of-experts, speculative decoding and diffusion language models, along with work on unlearning.

topics.label: Generative and Sequential Recommendation
topics.description: These papers build LLM-based recommender systems that generate semantic item IDs, model user histories and preferences, and suggest queries in e-commerce search.

topics.label: Self-Improving Reasoning and Self-Correction
topics.description: These papers improve model reasoning through self-evolution, reinforcement learning with guided exploration, latent reasoning and activation steering, alongside some work on calibration and abstention.

topics.label: Graph RAG and Multi-Hop QA
topics.description: These papers answer multi-hop questions by retrieving evidence over knowledge graphs, hypergraphs and document graphs, often with agentic or iterative retrieval.

topics.label: Psycholinguistics and Linguistic Knowledge Probing
topics.description: These papers compare language models with human sentence processing and test their syntactic, lexical and typological knowledge, with a mix of morphology, parsing and corpus work.

topics.label: Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
topics.description: These papers attack and defend tool-using agents against indirect prompt injection and build red-teaming methods and benchmarks for agent security.

topics.label: Agent Skill Libraries and Skill Evolution
topics.description: These papers let agents distill, retrieve, revise and evolve reusable procedural skills from execution traces, a topic that is new in 2026.

topics.label: Emotion Recognition and Affective Analysis
topics.description: These papers recognize, explain and control emotion, sentiment and stance in text and conversation, and probe how models represent affect internally.

topics.label: Document Information Extraction and Enterprise QA
topics.description: These papers extract structured information from corporate, financial and office documents and benchmark question answering over enterprise document collections, with some legal and biomedical extraction mixed in.

topics.label: Dense Retrieval and LLM Reranking
topics.description: These papers train dense and generative retrievers and LLM rerankers, with a focus on reasoning-intensive and efficient text retrieval.

topics.label: Spatial Reasoning and 3D Visual Grounding
topics.description: These papers evaluate and improve the spatial reasoning of vision-language models, including perspective taking, 3D visual grounding, geolocalization and remote sensing.

topics.label: Long and Streaming Video QA
topics.description: These papers help video language models answer questions about long and streaming videos through frame selection, evidence search and hierarchical multimodal memory.

topics.label: Machine Unlearning in Language Models
topics.description: These papers remove targeted knowledge from text and multimodal models while preserving utility, and test how robust the forgetting is to relearning and recovery attacks.

topics.label: Confidence Calibration and Knowledge Boundaries
topics.description: These papers study whether models know what they know, covering verbal confidence calibration, belief stability, honesty, overconfidence and hallucination mechanisms.

topics.label: Benchmark Construction and Evaluation Reliability
topics.description: These papers build new evaluation benchmarks across domains and languages and question benchmark validity through contamination detection, compression and diagnostic analysis.

topics.label: Cross-Lingual Transfer and Multilingual Representations
topics.description: These papers measure and close the gap between English and other languages through cross-lingual alignment, representation analysis, multilingual judges and multilingual training data.

topics.label: Automated Peer Review and Essay Scoring
topics.description: These papers generate, verify and audit scientific peer reviews with language models, alongside work on multi-trait essay scoring and deep research report evaluation.

topics.label: KV Cache Compression and Eviction
topics.description: These papers shrink the key-value cache for long-context inference through token eviction, quantization, low-rank approximation and adaptive per-layer budgets.

topics.label: Clarifying Questions and Information-Seeking QA
topics.description: These papers study how assistants ask clarifying questions, answer information-seeking and misconception-laden queries, and evaluate open QA, mixed with assorted conversation analytics and pragmatics work.

topics.label: Authorship Style and Creative Writing
topics.description: These papers analyze and transfer writing style for authorship attribution and personalized generation, and measure diversity and creativity in machine-written stories and poetry.

topics.label: Role-Playing Agents and Emotional Support Dialogue
topics.description: These papers train and evaluate role-playing characters, counseling and emotional support agents, and user simulators for multi-turn dialogue, with some general conversational assistant work.

topics.label: Multimodal and Text-to-Image Safety
topics.description: These papers benchmark and defend multimodal and text-to-image models against unsafe generation, jailbreaks and culturally specific risks, using safety unlearning, detoxification and guard models.

topics.label: Diffusion Language Models and Parallel Decoding
topics.description: These papers build, scale and speed up masked and continuous diffusion language models, with new remasking, parallel decoding, length control and distillation strategies.

topics.label: Attention, State-Space and Hybrid Architectures
topics.description: These papers analyze and redesign sequence model architectures such as Transformers, linear attention, Mamba-style state-space models and hybrids, covering positional encoding, attention sinks and layer representations.

topics.label: LLM-as-a-Judge Bias and Reliability
topics.description: These papers test how reliable LLM judges are, exposing position, self-preference and rubric biases and proposing debiasing, calibration and measurement-theory fixes, alongside a few fairness auditing studies.

topics.label: Long-Horizon Agents and World Models
topics.description: These papers train language agents for long-horizon interactive tasks using learned world models, experience reuse, context management and self-evolving policies in environments like ALFWorld and WebShop.

topics.label: Vision-Language Model Failures and Robustness
topics.description: These papers diagnose where vision-language models fail, including language priors overriding perception, framing effects, false premises, miscalibrated confidence and unfaithful visual grounding.

topics.label: Cultural Knowledge and Cultural Alignment
topics.description: These papers benchmark and steer how language models understand and adapt to cultural norms, values and region-specific knowledge across many languages and societies.

topics.label: Mathematical Reasoning and Formal Theorem Proving
topics.description: These papers improve and evaluate mathematical problem solving through verifiers, process reward models, distractor robustness, autoformalization and formal proof benchmarks.

topics.label: Medical Question Answering and Medical VQA
topics.description: These papers build and evaluate medical reasoning models for question answering and medical visual question answering, using reinforcement learning, multilingual medical data and evidence-grounded training.

topics.label: Optimization Modeling and Evolutionary Algorithm Discovery
topics.description: These papers use language models to formulate operations research and optimization problems and to evolve algorithms, code and designs through search-based self-improvement loops.

topics.label: Video Benchmarks and Text-to-Video Generation
topics.description: These papers benchmark and improve video-language models on temporal reasoning, captioning, cross-video question answering and text-to-video generation quality.

topics.label: Speech Language Models and Voice Agents
topics.description: These papers evaluate and build speech language models, spoken dialogue systems and voice agents, covering speech recognition, speech translation, TTS evaluation and multilingual speech benchmarks.

topics.label: AI-Generated Text Detection
topics.description: These papers detect and attribute machine-generated text with zero-shot statistics, probes and trained detectors, and audit detector shortcuts, robustness and cross-lingual performance.

topics.label: Model Pruning and Sparsity
topics.description: These papers compress language models through structured pruning, quantization and distillation and measure real inference speedups, while the cluster also mixes in assorted training, data selection and representation studies.

topics.label: Chemistry, Molecules and Drug Discovery
topics.description: These papers apply language models and agents to molecular property prediction, molecular optimization, retrosynthesis, structure elucidation, protein design and drug discovery.

topics.label: Long-Term Memory for Agents
topics.description: These papers design and benchmark long-term memory systems for conversational and personalized agents, covering memory extraction, consolidation, hierarchical organization and retrieval.

topics.label: Theory of Mind and Social Intelligence
topics.description: These papers benchmark theory-of-mind and social reasoning in text and multimodal models, from multi-party meetings and body language to deception and social deduction games.

topics.label: Clinical Reasoning and EHR Benchmarks
topics.description: These papers evaluate and train models for clinical decision making over electronic health records, multi-turn medical consultations and diagnosis, with a focus on evidence use and rubric-based assessment.

topics.label: Chart and Visual Document Reasoning
topics.description: These papers benchmark and improve vision-language models on charts, diagrams, scientific figures and text-rich images, with a few studies on art, manga and specialized layouts.

topics.label: Direct Preference Optimization and Personalized Alignment
topics.description: These papers refine preference alignment with token-weighted and noise-robust DPO variants, preference data selection, multi-objective steering and personalized or pluralistic alignment.

topics.label: Vision-Language Hallucination Mitigation
topics.description: These papers detect and reduce hallucinations, mostly object hallucinations in vision-language models, using attention-head interventions, activation steering, decoding fixes and new benchmarks.

topics.label: Speech Synthesis, Recognition and Audio Tokenizers
topics.description: These papers build and adapt speech and audio models for text-to-speech, speech recognition, streaming speech translation and audio tokenization.

topics.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Evidence Grounding
topics.description: These papers improve how RAG systems select, trust and cite retrieved evidence, covering knowledge conflicts, poisoning robustness, attribution and RAG evaluation.

topics.label: Dialects, Scripts and Underrepresented Languages
topics.description: These papers study dialects, writing systems and romanized or cross-script text in Arabic, Indic, African and other low-resource languages, alongside a mix of other language-specific resources and benchmarks.

topics.label: Domain Adaptation and Continual Pre-Training
topics.description: These papers adapt pretrained models to new domains through supervised fine-tuning, continual pre-training and parameter-efficient methods while limiting catastrophic forgetting of general skills.

topics.label: Compliance Checking and Auditing Agents
topics.description: These papers build agentic systems and benchmarks for claim verification, regulatory and advertising compliance checking, fraud detection and evidence-grounded auditing in applied domains.

topics.label: Machine Translation Quality Evaluation
topics.description: These papers evaluate machine translation with LLM judges, error span detection, document context and human studies, including literary and culturally loaded translation.

topics.label: Tool Use and Function Calling Agents
topics.description: These papers train and evaluate agents that select, retrieve and call external tools and APIs, with synthetic tool-use data, policy optimization and large tool ecosystems.

topics.label: Text Watermarking and Model Fingerprinting
topics.description: These papers embed and detect watermarks in generated text and fingerprint models for copyright protection, balancing detectability, robustness to edits and text quality.

topics.label: Proactive Agents and Implicit User Intent
topics.description: These papers benchmark and train agents that infer implicit user intent, elicit preferences and personalize multi-turn help in shopping, travel planning and assistant settings.

topics.label: Cognitive Bias, Sycophancy and Moral Judgment
topics.description: These papers probe language models with methods from psychology and social science, measuring sycophancy, cognitive and social biases, persuasion, moral reasoning and human-model behavioral gaps.

topics.label: Omni-Modal Models and Modality Robustness
topics.description: These papers examine modality bias, uncertainty and robustness in omni-modal and multimodal models, mixed with assorted work on incomplete multimodal learning, emotion recognition and multimodal data pipelines.

topics.label: GUI Agent Grounding and RL Training
topics.description: These papers build benchmarks, GUI grounding methods, world models and reinforcement learning recipes for agents that operate desktop, mobile and browser interfaces.

topics.label: Efficient and Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
topics.description: These papers cut overthinking in reasoning models through chain-of-thought compression, adaptive token budgets, early stopping, parallel thinking and latent or implicit reasoning.

topics.label: Deep Research and Search Agents
topics.description: These papers train and evaluate agents that run long-horizon web search for deep research, using reinforcement learning, synthetic search environments and trajectory synthesis.

topics.label: Human and LLM Data Annotation
topics.description: These papers study how humans and LLMs annotate data, covering annotator disagreement and label variation, noisy labels, annotation guidelines and cost-aware human-AI labeling pipelines.

topics.label: RLVR and On-Policy Distillation
topics.description: These papers refine reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and on-policy distillation for reasoning, tackling credit assignment, entropy collapse, advantage estimation and label-free rewards.

topics.label: Table Reasoning and Table Question Answering
topics.description: These papers answer questions and reason over tables, including multi-table retrieval, SQL-guided decomposition, table graphs and multimodal table images.

topics.label: Coding Agents for Software Engineering
topics.description: These papers benchmark and train coding agents on repository-level tasks such as issue localization, program repair, code retrieval and refactoring.

topics.label: User Simulators and Human Behavior Simulation
topics.description: These papers use language models to simulate users, personas and social behavior for evaluating agents and studying surveys and online discourse, and test how faithful these simulations are.

topics.label: Mixture-of-Experts Routing and Fine-Tuning
topics.description: These papers improve how MoE models route tokens to experts, prune or reduce experts at test time, and fine-tune MoE models without breaking their routing structure.

topics.label: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Reasoning Diagnostics
topics.description: These papers analyze why chain-of-thought reasoning fails, whether reasoning traces are faithful, and how to benchmark logical and causal reasoning, alongside work on overthinking and test-time compute.

topics.label: Visually Grounded Multimodal Reasoning with RL
topics.description: These papers train vision-language models to reason while keeping attention on visual evidence, using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, latent visual thinking and visual self-correction.

topics.label: Speculative Decoding and Inference Acceleration
topics.description: These papers speed up language model inference with draft models, draft trees, retrieval-based drafting and smarter verification, plus related work on efficient sampling.

topics.label: Document-Level and Low-Resource Translation
topics.description: These papers study how language models translate, build translation benchmarks and metrics, and improve document-level and low-resource machine translation with reasoning and reinforcement learning.

topics.label: Multi-Agent Debate and Argumentation
topics.description: These papers improve multi-agent debate for reasoning through better moderation, memory and aggregation, and study persuasion, counterargument generation and competitive debating.

topics.label: Event Extraction and Time-Series Grounding
topics.description: These papers extract events, arguments and timelines from documents and connect language with time-series data for event detection, forecasting and temporal explanation.

topics.label: Radiology Report Generation
topics.description: These papers generate and evaluate radiology reports from chest X-rays and CT scans with medical vision-language models that stay grounded in images and clinical findings.

topics.label: Social Bias, Stereotypes and Debiasing
topics.description: These papers measure and trace gender, racial and occupational stereotypes inside language models and debias them, with a share of work on steering vectors and refusal directions more generally.

topics.label: Legal Reasoning and Judgment Prediction
topics.description: These papers build benchmarks, retrieval systems and reasoning models for legal judgment prediction, legal case retrieval and legal question answering across jurisdictions.

topics.label: Text-to-SQL and Database Querying
topics.description: These papers translate natural language into SQL with schema linking, chain-of-thought training, reinforcement learning and candidate selection, and build more realistic text-to-SQL benchmarks.

topics.label: Scientific Discovery, Writing and Citations
topics.description: These papers use language models for research ideation, scientific discovery, paper writing and verification, and study how AI changes citation behavior and scientific prose.

topics.label: Entity Linking, Relation Extraction and Taxonomies
topics.description: These papers link entities to knowledge bases, extract relations and named entities, and induce taxonomies, mixed with assorted work on topic modeling, embedding geometry and intent discovery.

topics.label: Agent Benchmarks and Failure Diagnosis
topics.description: These papers benchmark and debug LLM agents on real-world planning, enterprise workflows and MCP tool use, and diagnose failures from agent execution trajectories.

topics.label: Safety Alignment and Over-Refusal
topics.description: These papers study how safety alignment and refusal work inside models, defend against jailbreaks and over-refusal, preserve safety during fine-tuning and benchmark content moderation.

topics.label: Synthetic Data Generation and Data Curation
topics.description: These papers generate, select and audit synthetic training data for instruction tuning, pretraining and low-resource tasks, and design data mixtures and recipes for model adaptation.

topics.label: Webpage, SVG and Text-to-Image Generation
topics.description: These papers generate and evaluate visual artifacts such as webpages, SVG graphics, diagrams, slides and charts from code, and benchmark text-to-image generation and editing.

topics.label: Multimodal RAG and Visual Document Retrieval
topics.description: These papers retrieve images and visually rich documents with multimodal embeddings and late interaction, and use them in multimodal retrieval-augmented generation for long-document question answering.

topics.label: MoE Compression and Efficient Training
topics.description: These papers compress, merge and quantize mixture-of-experts models and make MoE training and fine-tuning more efficient, alongside some work on the Muon optimizer and parallelism.

topics.label: GUI Agent Benchmarks and Simulators
topics.description: These papers build benchmarks, simulators and frameworks for agents that operate mobile apps, desktops and web interfaces, testing long-horizon tasks, ambiguity handling and safety.

topics.label: Code Generation, Testing and Repair
topics.description: These papers train and evaluate code models with unit-test generation, execution feedback, reward models and debugging to make generated code functionally correct.

topics.label: Knowledge Editing and Lifelong Model Editing
topics.description: These papers update or reverse specific facts and rules inside model parameters, covering batch, multi-hop, temporal and lifelong editing while preserving locality.

topics.label: AI Tutoring and Educational Dialogue
topics.description: These papers build and evaluate adaptive tutoring agents, student simulators and teacher-student dialogue corpora, alongside a smaller group of knowledge distillation papers pulled in by teacher-student wording.

topics.label: Agentic RL and Reward Design
topics.description: These papers improve reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents and reasoning with better credit assignment, rubric and process rewards, rollout budgeting and defenses against reward hacking.

topics.label: Personalization and Personality Alignment
topics.description: These papers adapt model responses to individual users through user profiles, memory selection, preference tracing, persona steering and personality or value alignment.

topics.label: Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLMs
topics.description: These papers cut inference cost in vision-language models by pruning, compressing or condensing visual tokens, with some papers on other efficiency and high-resolution adaptation methods for VLMs.

topics.label: Multi-Agent Collaboration and Communication
topics.description: These papers design and debug multi-agent LLM systems, covering role and topology adaptation, message pruning, latent communication, failure attribution and robustness to faulty agents.

topics.label: Fact-Checking and Factuality Evaluation
topics.description: These papers verify claims against retrieved evidence, score the factuality of long-form generations and detect fake news, including robustness to conflicting or adversarial evidence.

topics.label: Agent Safety and Tool-Use Risks
topics.description: These papers benchmark and guard tool-using agents against unsafe actions, prompt injection, malicious skills, privacy leaks and backdoors during multi-step execution.

topics.label: Low-Bit Weight and Activation Quantization
topics.description: These papers compress model weights, activations and KV caches with post-training, mixed-precision, ternary and quantization-aware methods that handle outliers.

topics.label: Knowledge Graph Reasoning and Link Prediction
topics.description: These papers reason over knowledge graphs and text-attributed graphs, covering KGQA, temporal knowledge graph forecasting, link prediction and graph serialization for language models.

topics.label: Audio-Language Model Understanding and Reasoning
topics.description: These papers benchmark and improve large audio-language models on acoustic perception, audio reasoning, bias, over-refusal and audio deepfake detection.

topics.label: LoRA and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
topics.description: These papers improve low-rank adaptation through rank allocation, initialization and multi-task packing, and use adapters to limit forgetting in continual and federated fine-tuning.

topics.label: Meme Understanding and Harmful Meme Detection
topics.description: These papers build multimodal models and multilingual benchmarks to interpret memes, humor and cultural references and to detect hateful or harmful memes.

topics.label: Detoxification and Moderation Evasion
topics.description: These papers reduce toxic generations, generate counterspeech and study how harmful content, fake news and poisoned corpora evade detectors, with a few loosely related robustness papers mixed in.

topics.label: Vision-Language-Action and Embodied Agents
topics.description: These papers build and diagnose vision-language-action policies for robot manipulation, navigation and autonomous driving, including grounding, planning and paraphrase robustness.

topics.label: Privacy Leakage, PII and Membership Inference
topics.description: These papers measure and mitigate privacy risks through PII detection, text sanitization, re-identification audits, membership inference and contextual integrity in agents.

topics.label: Financial NLP Benchmarks and Agents
topics.description: These papers evaluate and build models and agents for finance, covering financial reasoning benchmarks, retrieval, forecasting, trading, compliance and hallucination detection.

topics.label: Jailbreak and Backdoor Attacks
topics.description: These papers design jailbreak and backdoor attacks on language and vision-language models and defend against them with detection probes, guardrails and alignment interventions.

topics.label: Tokenization and Subword Vocabularies
topics.description: These papers analyze and redesign tokenizers, including byte-level, grapheme and morphology-aware subwords, and study their effect on multilingual and low-resource modeling.
